cover_letter_text:
Hello,

I am applying for the Trainee Civil Drafter role in North Sydney, which I saw on SEEK. Your advert says the trainee will be trained in packages such as AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with mentoring on projects for high profile clients.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019). From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, where I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked work against project requirements and carried out site inspections and quality checks.

I am based in Melton VIC. I will relocate to Sydney for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Marc Masarate

questions.question: Do you have current working rights that allows you to work in the country to are applying to?
questions.answer: Subclass 485 Temporary Graduate visa with full working rights until December 2027. No sponsorship needed.
